# Unifying Systems and Phenomeology: Equillibria

Equiilibria is an integral dynamic, a balancing force of systems, but why is it so? Equilblrium is the only defining force which keeps a system from collapse (in phen. terms, overwhelm) and depletion (phen. starvation)

In other words, Equillibria is the defining force which keeps a system online and alive; and Phenomenologically it is equillvalent.
